title: Insights into the antioxidant activity and metal chelation capacity of natural marine bromophenols: role of C–O–C and C–C linkages and the catechol group
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,22546-22555

Bromophenols are potent radical scavengers under both polar and lipid conditions. Their antioxidant potency is influenced by structural features such as the interunit linkage and the position of hydroxyl groups.
